description: Closest equivalent colours in ONE target brand for a known colour from a DIFFERENT brand, using MyHairMail's cross-brand colour mapping. Answers 'what is my shade called in brand X' — relevant when a colour is discontinued or out of stock, or when a shopper knows their shade in one brand and is shopping another. Returns up to 3 matches ranked by similarity (closest > close > approximate) with short tone notes, and when available an example_in_stock_style + product_url in the target brand. Same-brand requests are refused (use check_stock for other colours of the same brand). One source colour and one target brand per call; 'all brands' and wildcards are not supported. Unknown brand: supported_brands is returned. Terms: https://mcp.myhairmailtools.com/terms

source_brand.description: Brand of the known color, e.g. 'Jon Renau'

source_color.description: Color code or name, e.g. '12FS8' or 'Shaded Praline'

target_brand.description: Single brand to match into, e.g. 'Belle Tress'. Wildcards and 'all brands' are not supported.

name: color_crossmatch
title: Match a colour across wig brands
